items.text: Here’s today Ai prompt from @KSJ_Kreative @__Dave__1 @RudolphR70469 @brandt_lor23351 AI Prompt… MAKE ME A RIDICULOUS SUPERVILLAIN😁👀 Upload a clear photo of yourself… Prompt: Based ONLY on the personality, attitude, and energy you get from my photo, turn me into an over-the-top cinematic supervillain. Keep my face and identity recognizable, but completely transform my outfit, hairstyle, villain lair, throne, props, sidekick, and surroundings to match the character you invent. Create: * A hilarious villain name * A ridiculous superpower * An oddly specific weakness * The petty reason I became evil * The absurd thing I’m taking over Design it like a big-budget movie poster with my villain name large at the top and the other details in four small, easy-to-read panels around me. Make it dramatic, realistic, funny, slightly unhinged, and completely unique to the person in the photo. Do NOT tell me what you chose first. Just create the image and surprise me. 😈😂

items.author: m_zubaair
items.text: Part 1 — 30-Second Video Prompt Create a photorealistic cinematic MMA fight inside a packed UFC-style octagon, featuring two anthropomorphic fighters: a muscular brown macaque monkey wearing black MMA shorts and red gloves, and a muscular tan pit-bull-like humanoid fighter wearing black MMA shorts and blue gloves. Both fighters have realistic animal faces, human-like athletic bodies, and natural movement. Start with dramatic close-ups of the two fighters preparing and staring each other down inside the cage, with a huge excited crowd visible behind the black chain-link fence. The camera then moves into dynamic medium and close shots as they circle each other, maintaining defensive stances and throwing fast punches. Show realistic footwork, dodges, blocks, head movement, and powerful exchanges, with authentic MMA choreography and believable body physics. Use handheld ringside camera movement, occasional slow motion during major punches, realistic arena lighting, sweat, motion blur, detailed fur and skin, cinematic depth of field, and intense crowd atmosphere. Vertical 9:16, ultra-realistic, 4K, 24fps, dramatic sports-broadcast cinematography. Part 2 — 30-Second Video Prompt Continue with the exact same two fighters, same appearance, same clothing, same gloves, and same octagon environment for perfect visual continuity. The fight becomes more intense as the brown macaque and tan pit-bull-like fighter exchange powerful punches before closing the distance and entering a grappling sequence. The macaque gains control and takes the opponent toward the cage, followed by a realistic takedown that brings both fighters to the canvas. Transition into an intense ground-and-pound MMA sequence, with the fighter on top attempting controlled strikes while the opponent protects himself, scrambles, and tries to reverse the position. Include realistic grappling movements, arm control, leg positioning, defensive reactions, and physically believable momentum. Capture the action from multiple ringside angles, including dramatic low-angle shots and close-ups through the cage, while the crowd reacts loudly in the background. End with both fighters still engaged on the mat as the camera pushes in for a dramatic final shot. Photorealistic animal characters, realistic fur and muscles, authentic MMA choreography, cinematic arena lighting, natural motion blur, 4K, 24fps, vertical 9:16.

items.author: AIPromptmaste
items.text: What happens when a prompt is written like a creative brief? A futuristic cliffside residence suspended above the ocean — designed from a single detailed prompt. I focused on: • Cinematic composition • Blue-hour lighting • Realistic architecture • Physically accurate materials • Atmospheric depth • Camera + lens direction The goal isn’t just to generate an image. It’s to control the image. Prompt below 👇

items.author: Korgamiai
items.text: I am soo impressed with Tsubaki. Both image and video ☺️ Grok Image prompt: A maid in Kyoto Animation / Miss Kobayashi's Dragon Maid illustration style. Soft, organic, expressive, hand drawn aesthetic. Rounded forms, gently tapering limbs, relaxed asymmetry, believable balance, natural shoulder angles, subtle weight shifts. Personality expressed through gesture and silhouette. Clear face with soft cheeks, tapered jawline, expressive eyes, economical nose and mouth. Hair in rounded, flowing clumps with purposeful flyaways. Clean, supple contours with restrained line weight variation. Clothing hangs with convincing weight: broad sagging folds, gentle compression at joints, tension at seams. Harmonious palette, luminous midtones, soft ambient fill, simple cel shadows, subtle blush, sparse highlights. Graphite version: light B 2B pencil, smooth tonal masses, tapered strokes, deepened only at focal overlaps. Avoid rigid anatomy, angular exaggeration, glossy 3D rendering, photorealism, harsh shadows, stippling, hatching, noisy textures. Midjourney colourisation prompt: Maid Outfit dress charcoal: # 2B2B33 dress shadow: # 1A1A20 dress highlight: # 4A4A57 apron cream: # F7F0E1 apron shadow: # DCCFB8 frill white: # FFFBF2 sleeve cuff: # EFE4CF Hair hair base: # F2D9A0 hair highlight: # FFF0C8 hair shadow: # CDA866 hair band: # 2B2B33 Skin skin base: # FBE3D2 skin shadow: # EBC2A8 skin blush: # F4A9A0 Eyes eye iris: # 6B6F7A eye pupil: # 23232A eye highlight: # FFFFFF Shoes and Stockings shoe black: # 1C1C22 shoe shine: # 5A5A66 stocking white: # F5F1EA Accent (pick one) accent crimson: # B8323A accent gold: # D9A84B accent jade: # 4F8A78 Background and Line Art paper background: # F8EFE1 paper shadow: # E8DBC6 line art: # 4A4036 ground shadow: # CFC2AB English video prompt: A stunning martial arts action sequence. God-tier animation (sakuga), hand-drawn cel animation shot on twos, with a Harris shutter effect. A solo female character runs toward the camera and unleashes a continuous series of flying kicks, roundhouse kicks, and straight punches, with every strike grazing past the lens. Thick, bold smear frames feel weighty yet vanish in an instant, trailing off elegantly. Fluid, acrobatic choreography. Dynamic camerawork with zooms and whip pans, and quick resets. Wide long shots are mixed with powerful close-ups in a single continuous take, with the camera repeatedly pushing in and pulling back. Intense yet highly legible combo attacks. The camera is an unmanned virtual viewpoint: no other characters, no cameraman, no shot-reverse-shot cuts. Accurate human anatomy, stable drawing, and consistent character shape. Minimal studio space, stylized animation. Character design in the style of CloverWorks, action direction in the style of Zenless Zone Zero. Japanese video prompt: 圧巻の武術アクション。神作画のサクガ、2コマ打ちの手描きセルアニメーション、ハリスシャッター効果。単独キャラの彼女がカメラに向かって駆け出し、跳び蹴り、回し蹴り、正拳突きを連続で繰り出し、打撃はすべてレンズをかすめて通過する。太く濃いスミアフレームは重厚だが一瞬で消え、エレガントに尾を引く。流れるようなアクロバティックな殺陣。ダイナミックなカメラワーク、ズームとホイップパン、素早いリセット。広角ロングと迫力のアップを織り交ぜ、ワンカット長回し、カメラは押し引きを繰り返す。激しいが視認性の高い連撃。カメラは無人の仮想視点。他の人物なし、カメラマンなし、切り返しなし。正確な人体構造、安定した作画、キャラの形状を保つ。ミニマルなスタジオ空間、スタイライズされたアニメーション。キャラデザはCloverWorks風、アクション演出はゼンレスゾーンゼロ風。
